header: What the standard plan can handle
lead: The figures below are part of the standard plan contract. If a limit is soft, we say so here instead of changing it later without notice.
note: Figures apply per organisation. Enterprise plans have their own limits, which are stated in the contract.

rows.title: Sites per organisation
rows.text: A soft limit. Larger organisations run on their own instance.

rows.title: Rota history kept
rows.text: The same retention period as payroll records in Austria and Germany.

rows.title: Availability
rows.text: Measured monthly, not counting the announced Sunday maintenance window.

rows.title: Data centre
rows.text: The main copy and the replica are both in the European Union.

rows.title: Data export when you leave
rows.text: CSV and JSON, including the full audit trail.
